sloka: वैदह्या वचनं श्रत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् ।अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। ५.३८.४९।।।।
transliteration: vaidahyā vacanaṁ śratvā karuṇaṁ sāśrubhāṣitam ।athābravīnmahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 5.38.49।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the piteous words of Vaidehi and beholding her eyes filled with tears, the Windgod's son, lustrous Hanuman replied thus:.
